title: The Aftermath of Charlie Kirk’s Killing

sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.

sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bovaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·博瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, the political fallout from Charlie Kirk's murder and the manhunt for his killer.
sentences.zh: 今天，查理·柯克遇刺及其凶手搜捕行动引发的政治余波。

sentences.en: I speak with my colleague, Nicholas Bogle Burroughs.
sentences.zh: 我将与我的同事尼古拉斯·博格尔·伯勒斯交谈。
zh_words: 尼古拉斯·博格尔·伯勒斯

sentences.en: About why police are struggling to answer basic questions about the shooter.
sentences.zh: 探讨为何警方在回答有关枪手的基本问题时显得如此吃力。

sentences.en: And to Alan Foyer about how the assassination may be a turning point for the conservative movement.
sentences.zh: 并与艾伦·福耶尔探讨这次暗杀如何可能成为保守派运动的转折点。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月12日，星期五。

sentences.en: Nick, we are talking to you at about 6.35 p.m.
sentences.zh: 尼克，我们现在是下午6点35分和你通话。

sentences.en: Eastern time.
sentences.zh: 东部时间。

sentences.en: And I just want to start by asking you what we know about who carried out this assassination against Charlie Kirk and what we know about why they may have carried this out.
sentences.zh: 我想先问问你，关于是谁实施了针对查理·柯克的暗杀，以及他们为何这样做，我们目前掌握了什么信息？

sentences.en: We know incredibly little about both of those questions.
sentences.zh: 对于这两个问题，我们所知甚少。

sentences.en: We do not know who carried out this attack, and we don't know that person's motivations.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是谁实施了这次袭击，也不知道此人的动机。

sentences.en: It's been 30 hours since this assassination took place, and everyone's seen all these videos that have come out from the scene.
sentences.zh: 距离暗杀发生已经过去30个小时了，每个人都看到了现场流出的所有视频。

sentences.en: There's an incredible wealth of information about what happened, but almost nothing about the person who did this.
sentences.zh: 关于发生了什么，有海量的信息，但关于作案者，几乎一无所知。

sentences.en: And it felt like from the very beginning, there was a lot of confusion and mistaken identity.
sentences.zh: 而且从一开始，就感觉有很多混乱和身份误认的情况。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, as we've seen time and time again, unfortunately, there is a very quick response on the part of people online,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如我们一次又一次看到的那样，不幸的是，网络上的人反应非常迅速，

sentences.en: self-identified sleuths, to try to figure out who it could have been.
sentences.zh: 那些自诩的侦探们，试图找出凶手可能是谁。

sentences.en: And in this case, also some wrong guesses by the police, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来，这次警方也做出了一些错误的猜测。

sentences.en: There was two instances where people were taken into custody and questioned.
sentences.zh: 有两次，有人被拘留并接受了审问。

sentences.en: And in both cases, the police determined that those people had nothing to do with it, and they were released.
sentences.zh: 但在两起案件中，警方都确定这些人与案件无关，并将他们释放了。

sentences.en: And were they both people on the scene?
sentences.zh: 他们两人当时都在现场吗？

sentences.en: Is that the primary rationale for detaining them?
sentences.zh: 那是拘留他们的主要理由吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we don't know exactly why each of these people were detained, but one was an older man who's a political gadfly in Utah.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们不确定每个人被拘留的具体原因，但其中一人是犹他州的一位政治活跃分子。

sentences.en: People had a lot of familiarity with him, and he was cuffed right away, questioned presumably about what had happened, and then determined to not have anything to do with this.
sentences.zh: 人们对他很熟悉，他很快就被戴上手铐，大概是就发生的事情接受了询问，随后被确定与此无关。

sentences.en: The other person was a guy who seemed to just be in attendance of this rally.
sentences.zh: 另一个人似乎只是参加了这次集会。

sentences.en: I don't know why that person was brought in by the police, but they were very clear today that he was questioned and let go,
sentences.zh: 我不知道警方为何带走那个人，但他们今天明确表示，他接受了询问并被释放了，

sentences.en: and they said, you know, please don't harass him and his family.
sentences.zh: 他们说，请不要骚扰他和他的家人。

sentences.en: We should say in both cases, the names of these two men get widely circulated, and their reputations widely maligned, and it turns out they had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，在这两起案件中，这两个人的名字都被广泛传播，名誉也受到了严重损害，结果证明他们与此毫无关系。

sentences.en: That's right, and what happened then on Thursday morning was the police said that they had found on various surveillance video
sentences.zh: 没错，周四上午发生的事情是，警方表示他们在各种监控视频中发现了

sentences.en: images of the person that they believed was the gunman.
sentences.zh: 他们认为是枪手的人的影像。

sentences.en: This is now the third person that they considered a person of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这是他们目前认定的第三个相关人员。

sentences.en: They said, if we can't identify him on our own, we will seek the media's help in dispersing this picture.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果我们自己无法确认他的身份，我们将寻求媒体的帮助来发布这张照片。

sentences.en: Lo and behold, a few hours later, the FBI posts two grainy surveillance images onto social media of the person that they believe is the suspect.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，几个小时后，联邦调查局在社交媒体上发布了两张模糊的监控图像，显示的是他们认为的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: So that's a pretty clear indication that they were not able to identify him through other means, and we're now seeking the public's help.
sentences.zh: 所以这清楚地表明，他们无法通过其他方式确认他的身份，现在正在寻求公众的帮助。

sentences.en: I mean, what's your sense, Nick, about how it's possible we've gotten into the place we are where somebody carried out the assassination of Charlie Kirk,
sentences.zh: 尼克，你觉得我们怎么会走到这一步，有人暗杀了查理·柯克，

sentences.en: this enormously influential conservative leader, in an exceptionally public place, and was able to flee with what appears to have been such ease.
sentences.zh: 这位极具影响力的保守派领袖，在一个极其公开的场所，并且看起来如此轻松地逃脱了？

sentences.en: I think it helps to understand it by considering that it's not like an assassination attempt on Trump.
sentences.zh: 我认为考虑到这不像针对特朗普的暗杀企图，会有助于理解这一点。

sentences.en: It's not like a rally where you have the Secret Service and you have hundreds of police officers or, you know, extensive planning about the environment around a stage.
sentences.zh: 这不像集会，你有特勤局，有数百名警察，或者对舞台周围的环境有详尽的规划。

sentences.en: This is an event that brought 3,000 people to a Utah college campus, and the university police chief said that they had six officers working security,
sentences.zh: 这是一个将3000人带到犹他州大学校园的活动，大学警察局长说他们有六名警官负责安保，

sentences.en: plus Charlie Kirk's security team that he brings with him.
sentences.zh: 加上查理·柯克随身携带的安保团队。

sentences.en: Charlie Kirk is someone who's gone to a huge number of campuses, has had very controversial events, events that bring a lot of anger and support,
sentences.zh: 查理·柯克去过很多校园，举办过非常有争议的活动，这些活动带来了很多愤怒和支持，

sentences.en: and it's not the kind of thing that is planned for in the same way, though, that a presidential rally or a political rally would be.
sentences.zh: 但这与总统集会或政治集会那种规划方式不同。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This ratio you're describing of police to 3,000 crowd suggests that the people involved in putting this event together and even the security team around Charlie Kirk
sentences.zh: 你描述的警察与3000名人群的比例表明，参与组织这次活动的人，甚至查理·柯克身边的安保团队，

sentences.en: just didn't see him as a major target.
sentences.zh: 只是没把他看作是一个主要目标。

sentences.en: I think that's right, and I think also if you look at what the police have outlined is happening, I mean, this is a pretty extreme attack.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样，而且如果你看看警方概述的情况，这确实是一次非常极端的袭击。

sentences.en: This is a single gunshot from the roof of a building from far behind where the crowd is.
sentences.zh: 这是一发从人群后方很远处的建筑物屋顶射出的子弹。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, you're starting to do this, but describe, in the absence of an understanding of who did this and why they did it,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你刚才开始说了，但在不了解是谁干的以及为什么干的情况下，请描述一下，

sentences.en: what the police do know about the movements of this shooter who did what he did and so far has gotten away with it.
sentences.zh: 警方对这个枪手的行踪了解多少，他做了什么，以及到目前为止他是如何逃脱的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So they say that they have surveillance footage that shows him arriving near the campus around 11.52 a.m.
sentences.zh: 他们说有监控录像显示他在上午11点52分左右到达校园附近，

sentences.en: local time, that they then can track him as he moves into a building and up a stairwell and onto the roof of this building that looks down over a basically amphitheater
sentences.zh: 当地时间，然后他们可以追踪他进入一栋建筑，走上楼梯，来到这栋建筑的屋顶，俯瞰着一个露天剧场，

sentences.en: where Charlie Kirk was speaking.
sentences.zh: 查理·柯克当时就在那里演讲。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Kind of an outdoor quad-looking space on campus.
sentences.zh: 校园里一个看起来像室外方庭的地方。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And up on this roof, the shooter has a high-powered bolt-action rifle.
sentences.zh: 在屋顶上，枪手拿着一把大威力栓动步枪。

sentences.en: The police say he fired that single shot and then ran to another side of the roof where he was able to jump down from it.
sentences.zh: 警方说他开了那一枪，然后跑到屋顶的另一侧，从那里跳了下去。

sentences.en: And I recall that there is some video of him running across the roof.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一段他跑过屋顶的视频。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's a video that captures someone, presumably the shooter, running across the roof right after the shooting has taken place.
sentences.zh: 有一段视频捕捉到了某人，大概就是枪手，在枪击发生后立即跑过屋顶。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Just looking, exploring the geography of this campus has been really interesting because it really looks like the gunman would have had the ability to take that shot,
sentences.zh: 研究这个校园的地理位置真的很有趣，因为看起来枪手确实有能力开那一枪，

sentences.en: go back to another side of the roof, jump down, and then very, very quickly be off campus.
sentences.zh: 回到屋顶的另一侧，跳下去，然后非常非常快地离开校园。

sentences.en: He's basically on the edge of campus.
sentences.zh: 他基本上就在校园边缘。

sentences.en: The police said that they recovered that rifle that they think he used from a wooded area right near the campus.
sentences.zh: 警方说他们在校园附近的一片树林里找回了他们认为他使用的步枪。

sentences.en: And they've spent much of the last 30 hours combing through this area, speaking with neighbors, speaking with folks who live there.
sentences.zh: 过去30个小时里，他们大部分时间都在搜查这个区域，与邻居交谈，与住在那里的人交谈。

sentences.en: Do we know anything about how he left the campus?
sentences.zh: 我们知道他是如何离开校园的吗？

sentences.en: What direction he went in?
sentences.zh: 他往哪个方向走了？

sentences.en: If it was on foot?
sentences.zh: 是步行吗？

sentences.en: If it was in a car?
sentences.zh: 还是坐车？

sentences.en: Anything.
sentences.zh: 什么都行。

sentences.en: The police have not been clear about those details or whether they know those details.
sentences.zh: 警方没有明确说明这些细节，或者他们是否掌握这些细节。

sentences.en: The one thing that they have indicated is that he went through some wooded area where he ditched the gun.
sentences.zh: 他们指出的唯一一点是，他穿过了一些树林，并在那里丢弃了枪支。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: There has been a report circulating throughout Thursday that I want to better understand.
sentences.zh: 周四全天流传着一份报告，我想更好地了解一下。

sentences.en: It revolves around the casings from the weapon that was fired at this scene, from this rifle.
sentences.zh: 它围绕着在现场发射的武器弹壳，从这把步枪里射出的。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you can tell us about that and how much attention we should be paying to those casings.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能不能告诉我们关于那件事的情况，以及我们应该对这些弹壳给予多少关注。

sentences.en: To be very clear, the truth is I don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 说实话，真相是我还不知道。

sentences.en: And I think very few people do.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为很少有人知道。

sentences.en: There's been reporting in a couple of outlets that suggest that some of the ammunition that was left with the gun was engraved with, and this is the phrasing that they're using,
sentences.zh: 有一些媒体报道暗示，留在枪支附近的一些弹药上刻有——这是他们使用的措辞——

sentences.en: transgender, anti-fascist ideology.
sentences.zh: 跨性别、反法西斯意识形态。

sentences.en: Right, and this made its way into a law enforcement bulletin.
sentences.zh: 没错，这出现在了一份执法公告中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is something that was circulated among some group of law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 这是在某些执法部门之间传阅的内容。

sentences.en: Our reporting has been very unclear on how accurate that is.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道对于其准确性一直非常不明确。

sentences.en: And at this point, there's very little evidence of any motive.
sentences.zh: 目前，几乎没有任何动机的证据。

sentences.en: I also haven't seen in any of those reports what that actual marking that's supposedly on the ammunition would actually say.
sentences.zh: 我也没在任何报道中看到那些弹药上所谓的标记到底写了什么。

sentences.en: It's only been described in this sort of vague way second or third hand.
sentences.zh: 它只是以这种模糊的方式被二手或三手地描述过。

sentences.en: You know, we have a whole team of reporters trying to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们有一整个记者团队在试图弄清楚这件事。

sentences.en: We're all very interested in what the motive is for this attack.
sentences.zh: 我们都非常关心这次袭击的动机是什么。

sentences.en: And right now, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们还不知道。

sentences.en: You've covered a lot of manhunts in your career.
sentences.zh: 你的职业生涯中报道过很多搜捕行动。

sentences.en: Does everything you're describing here feel typical?
sentences.zh: 你在这里描述的一切感觉典型吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes people do get away for some period of time.
sentences.zh: 有时人们确实会逃脱一段时间。

sentences.en: Frequently, they're caught in the end.
sentences.zh: 最终他们经常会被抓住。

sentences.en: Or does this all feel, especially the confusion in the beginning, the detentions and the releases, a little bit bumbling, especially given the stakes
sentences.zh: 或者这一切，特别是开始时的混乱、拘留和释放，感觉有点笨拙，考虑到利害关系

sentences.en: and the profile of Charlie Kirk?
sentences.zh: 以及查理·柯克的知名度？

sentences.en: When something this high profile happens, you certainly expect that the person who carried it out is going to be taken into custody very quickly.
sentences.zh: 当发生这种高调的事情时，你当然期望实施者会被迅速拘留。

sentences.en: The unique aspect of this is the fact that we have no name, that we don't know who did this.
sentences.zh: 这件事独特的地方在于我们没有名字，我们不知道是谁干的。

sentences.en: It's not just, we're looking for this guy.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是我们在找这个人。

sentences.en: It's, we want to know who this guy is.
sentences.zh: 而是我们想知道这个人是谁。

sentences.en: I think that's very unusual.
sentences.zh: 我认为这非常不寻常。

sentences.en: When I think of other manhunts in recent years in Maine or Montana, it was always, here's the guy we're looking for and we're narrowing in on him.
sentences.zh: 当我想到近年来在缅因州或蒙大拿州的其他搜捕行动时，总是说，这是我们要找的人，我们正在缩小包围圈。

sentences.en: And maybe it takes a few days.
sentences.zh: 也许需要几天时间。

sentences.en: In almost every manhunt I've covered, the person has been found very close to where the crime took place.
sentences.zh: 在我报道过的几乎每一次搜捕中，嫌疑人都是在离犯罪现场很近的地方被发现的。

sentences.en: They've been scrounging for food or in someone's backyard.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在找食物，或者躲在某人的后院里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I don't want to speculate too much, but if this person had a plan before carrying this out, there's a lot of things you can do in 30 hours when the police don't know who you are.
sentences.zh: 我不想做太多推测，但如果此人在实施之前有计划，当警方不知道你是谁时，30个小时内你可以做很多事情。

sentences.en: I mean, you could try to leave the country, you could try to leave the state, you could drive a far distance, you could get on a train.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以尝试离开这个国家，你可以尝试离开这个州，你可以开车走很远，你可以坐火车。

sentences.en: There's a lot less risk when the police don't have a flag out for your name.
sentences.zh: 当警方没有发布针对你名字的通缉令时，风险要小得多。

sentences.en: I have to wonder if that helps explain why over the past few hours we have seen the director of the FBI,
sentences.zh: 我不禁想知道，这是否有助于解释为什么在过去几个小时里，我们看到联邦调查局局长、

sentences.en: Kash Patel, and his number two,
sentences.zh: 卡什·帕特尔，以及他的二把手、

sentences.en: Dan Bongino, both prominent conservative figures in their own right announced that they are headed to Utah to oversee this investigation.
sentences.zh: 丹·邦吉诺，这两位本身就是著名的保守派人物，宣布他们正前往犹他州监督这项调查。

sentences.en: Should that be seen as a sign that they are frustrated with where this investigation stands and how little has been confirmed?
sentences.zh: 这是否应该被视为他们对调查现状以及确认信息之少感到沮丧的信号？

sentences.en: I think it could be that.
sentences.zh: 我认为可能是那样。

sentences.en: I think this is, of course, just an incredibly high-profile investigation into an assassination.
sentences.zh: 我认为这当然是一项针对暗杀的极其高调的调查。

sentences.en: I think you're right that the pressure is certainly on.
sentences.zh: 我认为你说得对，压力肯定很大。

sentences.en: The FBI director was the person who was saying shortly after the shooting that there was a subject in custody, and that ended up being one of the two people
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局局长在枪击事件发生后不久就说有一名嫌疑人被拘留，结果那竟然是他们不得不释放的两个人之一。

sentences.en: that they had to release.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一个人，
